{{Quote|Three lives for five&hellip;a rather poor trade, wouldn't you say?|Jan Ors to Alfonso Luiz Obota|<ref name="DF">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>}}
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] attempted to '''infiltrate''' an [[Unidentified planet (Alliance Special Ops operation)|Imperial planet]]. The [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Spirit of Solaris|''Pride of Aridus'']], under the guise of discharging a legitimate cargo, landed a twelve-men team of [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], who&mdash;according to the insertion plan&mdash;were supposed to come back in exactly six [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. The team's cover, however, was blown, and the group was late by two [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nord (Rebel)|Nord]] was almost ready to leave without them when the commandos finally raced toward the ship under heavy fire from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.

As the ''Pride of Aridus'' fell under fire as well, Nord gave the order to take off, intent on leaving the SpecOps team behind. Not willing to abandon his fellow Rebels, the ship's second officer, [[Second Lieutenant/Legends|Second Lieutenant]] [[Alfonso Luiz Obota]] punched Nord in the face and confined him in his cabin. Obota then seized control of the ship and waited for the commandos, three of whom were able to reach the ship and were successfully extracted thanks to Obota's actions. However, when the ''Pride of Aridus'' finally lifted off and reached the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], it was attacked by several [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]]. In the ensuing battle, five crew members were killed, and the ship suffered serious damage, barely escaping by making a jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
